body:
## Code Review

This pull request adds a new smoke test suite and runtime validation script (`full-beta-visual-blocked-runtime-smoke.mjs`) along with unit tests and generated readback artifacts. The review feedback identifies a logic bug in the target de-duplication key generation that prevents duplicate URLs from being filtered, and suggests optimizing lookup performance by using a `Set` for real-usage question keys. Additionally, it recommends expanding unit test coverage to include fail-closed scenarios for missing or malformed input files.

> [!IMPORTANT]
> The [consumer version of Gemini Code Assist on GitHub](https://developers.google.com/gemini-code-assist/docs/review-repo-code) is being sunset. Starting **June 18, 2026**, new organization installations will be blocked, and all code review activity will officially cease on **July 17, 2026**.
> For more details on the timeline and next steps, please review the [Help Documentation](https://developers.google.com/gemini-code-assist/docs/deprecations/consumer-code-review).
